name: macOS Hardening Assessment
description: Assessment of macOS endpoint hardening configurations. Covers Gatekeeper and XProtect configuration, System Integrity Protection (SIP) verification, TCC framework and privacy controls, FileVault encryption assessment, MDM security profile review, Endpoint Security framework configuration, macOS firewall and network controls, and CIS Apple macOS Benchmark compliance.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to macOS hardening assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands macOS security architecture and hardening concepts
evidence: Can explain Gatekeeper, SIP, TCC, and FileVault at a conceptual level
Familiar with CIS Apple macOS Benchmark structure and applicability
Understands MDM-managed vs standalone macOS security configurations
Completed introductory training on macOS security hardening

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Runs macOS hardening assessment tools and reviews configurations under supervision
evidence: Runs macOS Security Compliance Project (mSCP) or CIS-CAT under guidance
Reviews system preferences, configuration profiles, and security settings using checklists
Assesses FileVault configuration and recovery key management
Documents findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses macOS hardening and provides contextualized remediation
evidence: Independently assesses macOS endpoints against CIS benchmarks
Evaluates TCC database integrity and privacy preference policy controls
Assesses MDM-deployed configuration profiles for security effectiveness
Produces compliant hardening assessment reports with macOS-specific remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom macOS hardening baselines; handles managed fleet environments
evidence: Develops organization-specific macOS hardening baselines using mSCP
Assesses complex managed environments with Jamf, Kandji, or similar MDM
Evaluates Endpoint Security framework configuration and third-party security tools
Reviews hardening assessment work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab macOS hardening methodology; contributes to industry standards
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's macOS hardening assessment framework
Contributes to CIS Apple macOS Benchmark or mSCP development
Trains teams on advanced macOS hardening assessment
Recognized as authority on macOS endpoint security configuration

assessment_methods.description: Assess a set of macOS endpoints with varying hardening levels including MDM-managed and standalone configurations
Review macOS hardening assessment findings and remediation guidance from recent engagements
